about: TVRecs starter catalog (2026-11-12): OLED, Mini-LED & QLED (8K included) and budget/mid-range TVs from model years 2023-2026, approved by the owner 2026-11-12, plus older models added under the owner's 3-author rule (LG C2/C1/CX/C9/C8/C7/B7/G2/G1, Samsung S95B/QN90B/QN90A, Sony A80J/A80K/A90J/A95K/X900H). One product per model and year; all screen sizes of a model share an entry. Names are read on the makers' own pages (product, support and spec pages, newsrooms) or retailer pages showing the maker's model code; a name the maker reused in a later year carries that year in parentheses. Specs: shape = category, balance = panel, surface = sizes, core = refresh rate and HDMI 2.1, weight = smart TV platform. Blank = not confirmed.
